title: Bottom-hat
text: Perform morphological bottom-hat filtering on intensity or binary images, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Neighborhood or structuring element} sets Neighborhood or structuring element; {Input image type} sets the type of input and {Neighborhood or structuring element source} sets the source of neighborhood or structuring element Specify via. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Input image type
params.values: Type of input image Intensity (default) | Binary

params.name: Neighborhood or structuring element source
params.values: Source of neighborhood or structuring element Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Neighborhood or structuring element
params.values: Neighborhood or structuring element strel(’octagon’,15) (default) | vector | matrix
